name: Ghostemane
notes: The occult/industrial pole of trap metal, self-produced. Three parameters carry the research. (1) The riffs are tritone- and b2-centred against Memphis minor loops, so `halfStepDissonance` is 0.48 — above even this genre's 0.3 — the interval budget is leap-heavy rather than stepwise, and the harmony families are the ones the paragraph writes out: static i, i–bII, i–VI–VII. Nothing here is an invented progression. (2) The melodic layer is bells, choirs and *pitched-down* chants, which is why `melody.register` sits at 60–88, a full octave under the genre's bell octave, and `timbreHint` is `chant_stab`. (3) The signature structural move is the abrupt genre switch between sections — trap verse into metal breakdown — so `switchUpProb` is 0.55, the highest in this batch. Power chords are root-and-5th, which the engine has no name for; `voicing.style` is `open` with `susOrDimProb` 0.4, because a sus voicing is the nearest thing here to a chord with no third. Industrial-metal layers are `percs.lanes` `impact`/`reverse`/`crash`. ⚠ `medium` because the research rates it medium: self-production, influences and genre position are documented, but there is no chart verification and no tempo or drum documentation. The INFERRED parameters are therefore the whole `session.bpm` range and every number in `drums.kick`, `drums.hihat` and `drums.snareRoll` — the research marks tempi and drum specifics `[LOW-CONF]` explicitly. `snareRoll.pitchWalk` is inherited rather than authored, because the research says nothing about how he pitches a roll. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 955 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 970/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, arp, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,4] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 969/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.16 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 969/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
